description: The carriers and labware AHC's Hamilton STARlet accepts in a layout, copied from AHC 0.9.0 (github.com/xthomaswang/ahc, src/ahc/devices/hamilton/starlet.md, `layout`, 2026-11-11). pipeline/ahc_export.py exports only these; AHC refuses anything else (carrier_not_allowed). AHC runs PyLabRobot 1.0, whose names can differ from 0.2.2's in case only (Cor_96_wellplate_360ul_Fb here, cor_96_wellplate_360uL_Fb in this pipeline), so names are matched ignoring case. Update this list when AHC adds types.
